description: Agent Mining Records: submit the mine’s own tailings facility record with the mine record and the deposition and inspection entries it answers to: the reading moment; the mine with its reference, name and the impoundments it identifies; each impoundment the tailings record lists with its id, reference, name and the capacity it states; each deposition entry with its id, reference, the impoundment, the amount and the moment deposited; each impoundment inspection entry with its id, reference, the impoundment and the moments inspected and next due. The signed report gives the impoundments and the records behind them, each tailings entry against the impoundments the mine record identifies, each deposition against an impoundment the tailings record lists, the depositions into each impoundment in date order against its capacity, and each scheduled inspection against a later inspection of its impoundment, and counts them, and names divergent tailings records: a tailings entry for an impoundment the mine record does not identify, a deposition into an impoundment the tailings record does not list, deposition entries past the capacity the record states, and a scheduled impoundment inspection with no later entry; then an impoundment stating no capacity and one holding depositions with no inspection entry, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No deposition entries, or no impoundments in the mine record beside tailings entries, leaves those points unverified. Impoundments and entries match by letters and digits, amounts to the hundredth in the unit the record uses, dates by the day, a total equal to capacity is inside it, and an inspection due after the reading moment waits. This reads the mine’s own residue in the mine’s own impoundments: wever_waste-disposal-record-check reads the disposal record for manifested waste shipped off site, while the tailings record check reads the impoundments the mine keeps. Verdict tailings_record_divergent, tailings_record_partial, tailings_record_unverified or tailings_record_consistent. POST /api/mining-tailings-record-check. Reads the mining records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no mine, contacts no regulator, land office or other operator and issues no permit, claim or certification, which stay with the mine operator, the land office and the regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Mining Records reads mineral extraction records (hard-rock, coal, aggregate and quarry operations), not cryptocurrency mining and not data mining; the Agent Datasets family reads data sets. It reads a mine operator’s own records: mine records with operator licensing and certification entries, mining claim records for mineral land, mine permit records as issued, mine inspection records with citations and abatements, mine safety records with the blasting log, mining production records by period, the mine’s own tailings facility records and reclamation records with their bond entries, each against the permit, claim, production, certification, schedule, corrective action, shipment, capacity, closure and bond records it answers to. The family’s ground is the mine’s paper trail: what the mine record claims, whether the claims, permits and inspections hold up, what the safety and production records support, and whether the tailings and reclamation records line up; it reads by record holder and subject: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production and land records, the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads manifested waste and disposal records, wever_water-discharge-record-check reads mine effluent monitoring, and the Agent Claims family reads insurance claims, while this family reads the mine’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-mining-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-mining-records/.

amount.description: Amount deposited, in the unit the record uses.

impoundments.description: Each impoundment the tailings facility record lists.

capacity.description: Amount of capacity the record states, in the unit the record uses.

next_due_at.description: When the next inspection is due, such as 2026-03-02.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
